title: Dissolve Ember plates through light and bake the next plate early
acceptance: R1 over 60 s: centre brightness never falls below 60% of its 1 s running median for more than one frame.
R5 at plate rotation: no task over 100 ms at 390x844 @3 with 4x CPU throttle after the first 2 s.

evidence.note: Package A2; requirements R1 and R5.
Investigation of production 97ca014f: probe measurements, code references and the last 14 days of history.

activity.summary: Seeded from Phase A of the Consolidated Reader proposal; needs no owner decision.

summary: Ember holds the new plate at progress 0 during the dissolve (plate-field.js:243): about 4 s near black every ~15.5 s, and a ~1 s freeze at rotation on a throttled phone.
